Question 1

The cubic polynomial P(x) has roots x1=2,x2=x3=4, and the coefficient of the cubic term is −5. Find P(x).

a
5x3−50x2+15x−15
b
−5x3+50x2−160x+160
c
−5x3+50x2−15x+15
d
5x3−50x2+160x−160
e
−5x3−20x2−70x+70
